name: Saran
source:
The Quirky Animal Tamer

It’s not every day that you run into a girl with a whip, but despite her daunting looks, Saran’s infectious positivity draws you in.

Can you help her connect with her classmates the same way she does with animals?

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1501181182804910080?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
